title: Database client and schema
routing: Is this about reaching Postgres through Prisma or shaping the schema? Signals: importing or calling db / db.txn / db.onCommit / db.onFinally / db.findForUpdate / db.raw / db.scope / db.isInTxn, `$transaction` or `new PrismaClient`, the query.* delegate helpers (passing `db.user` to a generic helper), editing packages/db/prisma/schema/*.prisma (UUIDv7 ids, VarChar(36) FKs, createdAt/updatedAt, enum suffixes, a polymorphic ownerModel / sourceModel / resourceModel plus typed FK columns, PolymorphismRegistry / getPolymorphismConfig), branded model IDs (UserId, organizationId()), partial-unique or CHECK constraints (addUniqueWhereNotNull, addCheckConstraint), and country / currency / language / timezone codes or their zod schemas.
